gb: GB is a highly toxic chemical nerve agent that inhibits the activity of cholinesterase.
GB can also mean a unit of magnetomotive force equal to 0.7958 ampere-turns.
GB can also mean a unit of information equal to 1000 megabits or 10^9 bits.
GB means the same as sarin or gilbert or Gi.
gbit: Gbit is a unit of information equal to 1000 megabits or 10^9 bits.
Gbit means the same as gigabit or Gb.
gbu-28: GBU-28 is a 5,000 pound laser-guided bomb that can be programmed to penetrate to a given depth before exploding.
GBU-28 means the same as Bunker Buster or Guided Bomb Unit-28.
